model_output.verdict: A senior marketing manager’s experience, with consulting work that leaves a recruiter guessing about recent results.
write_up: It’s common for consulting work to end up as a list of services rather than projects. Your resume moves from marketing leadership at Velocity Software to freelance consulting, but the recent work doesn’t say how much you did or what changed. I read it for Freelance Marketing Consultant; a recruiter may hesitate to move it forward without those details.

The Velocity line about managing 4 marketers and a $1.8M annual budget is a strong model: it gives a recruiter a concrete picture of your remit. Your progression at Bridgepoint and the reason the Velocity role ended are also easy to follow.

Let’s start with the freelance role. Add what you delivered for clients and any results you can share, then bring the same detail to the ABM and webinar work. Your Velocity leadership and MQL results give you solid material for the senior marketing role you’re seeking.
